description: The Uttar Pradesh government, led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, is taking major steps to position the state as a leading digital and artificial intelligence (AI) hub in India.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh government, led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, is taking major steps to position the state as a leading digital and artificial intelligence (AI) hub in India. As part of this vision, the state plans to develop eight large data center parks across key cities, with an estimated investment of ₹2 lakh crore and the potential to create around 50,000 direct jobs.
